findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: a pinTimeZone call that throws leaves process.env.TZ unchanged. Actual: it sets TZ before checking and throws before registering the restore, so a failed pin leaves the bad zone in the worker. The file still fails at load, so there is no false pass.
findings.fix: Restore the saved TZ before throwing (optional).
